quest.title: As the Khvarena's Light Shows: Nirodha
quest.description: With Nasejuna's aid, you now know where the Great Songs might be found. One of them is hidden within a Khaenri'ahn underground ruin...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Primogem x60, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Obtain the Great Song of Khvarena from the ruins
Go to the entrance to the underground ruins

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"Turn the gears such that all three types of runes are displayed. Ensure that the square rune is connected to the triangular rune at the bottom without changing said triangle."</color> Simply do as I instruct, and we should be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That weird cannon emerged from the ground! Are they trying to say that we should shoot that big machine over there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Such a thoughtful design.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Your imagination truly is wild, Pale Floater. Did Nasuraia not say earlier that this place was modified from its original form as a proving ground for testing machine functionality?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: It appears that the device we unlocked earlier was meant to be used to activate the proving ground.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: It seems that the modifications did not include the dismantling of the original devices. A most helpful discovery indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: In that case, my Yasnapati, the honor of operating this cannon shall be yours.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Behold, the moment of destiny is at hand!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is just a normal mechanical door!

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: *cough* I mean to say that as long as we open this mechanical door, we will gain access to the ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Haha, this is my first time entering a Dahrian ruin, you know? Is it so surprising that I might be excited?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? You sounded so confident earlier that Paimon thought you must've explored loads of ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Hah! Well, I can't claim to have personally explored them. But with this copy of "Rene's Investigation Notes," written as it is by an excellent scholar of ancient histories, it is as though I were there in the flesh!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Rene's Investigation Notes"?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Have you never heard of it? I thought that only one sequestered in a distant desert such as I would not have heard of such a brilliant scholar.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: These notes contain a lot of records left by the people of Dahri. According to the author, he once discovered knowledge that "surpasses mortals" in these ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This sounds harder to believe by the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Leaving that aside for the moment, now that we have these notes, entering these Dahrian ruins should be a simple matter.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: If you don't believe me, let's test this! For example, if we'd like to open this device... Oh, there we go!

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>"Turn the gears such that all three types of runes are displayed. Ensure that the square rune is connected to the triangular rune at the bottom without changing said triangle."</color> Simply do as I instruct, and we should be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Looks like we've finally reached the heart of these ruins. Now then, as the one amongst us who has done a fair amount of research into Dahrian ruins, allow me to tell you all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: According to the notes I have, this was once a proving ground where the Dahrians would conduct research and tests. The Great Song of Khvarena we seek is at the deepest part of this facility.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: If we want to reach it, we'll first have to, hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You were just saying that you'd done your homework, and you're fumbling about already?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Well, the makeup of these ruins really is too complicated. I doubt anyone could fully understand the principles behind the mysterious machines that the Dahrians used just from descriptions alone.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Let me see... Ah, there we go. Looks like our current position is that of the control hub for the entire proving ground.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: If we wish to reach the Great Song, we must first activate the entire ruins' control mechanisms. To do so, we have to solve an energy issue.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Though the people of Dahri are said to have been able to use the power of impurity to operate machines and master monsters, it seems that these ruins don't do so.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: On the contrary, it seems that they used a form of energy known as Azosite. It was drawn from pure elemental energy before being formed into blocks.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: That means that as long as we find an Energy Block of this kind, we will be able to provide energy to these cores, after which we should be able to settle any other problems with ease.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: That sounds troublesome. Now if only we could simply settle this through combat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, let's begin, then.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Ah, raring to go, I see. That's the Envoy's Yasnapati, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: In that case, I will leave the work of searching for the Energy Block to you. This is a set of schematics that shows the layout of the proving ground. I'm sure you'll put it to good use.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: In the meantime, I have some other things I must examine. As such, I'll wait for you to return here. With the honored Envoy by your side, this shall be child's play — I know it.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: If you encounter any issues, just examine these schematics a bit more closely.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Just install the Energy Block into these Energy Cores, and the whole control system should start!

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: It is just as the notes say... Hmm? You're back already?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: But judging from your appearance, you must've found the Energy Block we require.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: I have examined these Energy Cores... They are very well-preserved. Now, all that is needed is to install the Energy Block into them.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: ...And that, I shall leave in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: What is it? Is there some problem?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: You need only follow the schematics, find the Energy Block, and return here.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: The Energy Cores have been filled. Now, we should be able to activate the control systems...

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Huh? That wasn't what I was expecting. Is there a problem somewhere?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: It seems as if we'll need to go have a look at the control center where the relays are. Which is fine, it's on the way to the proving ground all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Well now, it seems the control center is in the direction you previously came from. Since that's the case, let's go together!

talks.objective: Go to the control center where the relays may be found

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: As I thought. The problem lies with these relays. The energy from the Energy Cores isn't reaching them. We need to find a way to connect them...

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: And some of the relays in this place have been sealed in crystal... But since these ruins don't use impurities as an energy source, they shouldn't have come to the attention of Khvarena at all...

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: The only explanation for that has to be that this place was intentionally sealed by someone with the ability to use Khvarena. But why would they do that? What are they trying to hide?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Well, I suppose this can be discussed later. Our current task is still to use Khvarena's power to remove the Gray Crystals that have formed those seals.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: There should be Farrwicks nearby that contain Khvarena's power. I believe you can sense it too, mighty Envoy?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Umm... Hmph. Of course! Are you doubting my majestic power as the Bloomguard?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Hardly, I would never dare! Please, great and eminent Envoy, guide us.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: We just need to find the Farrwicks, remove the Gray Crystals, and then use the mixer once again to connect these relays.

talks.objective: Investigate the door on the left side

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Great Envoy, and her honored Yasnapati, I fear that this is as far as I may attend you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what's the problem this time?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: According to the texts, the road ahead is full of perils that no ordinary mortal may bear.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Once we go in here, we shall be within the proving ground that the Dahrians once used to test their machines. There is even an incomplete prototype of a giant machine amongst them.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: The copied Dahrian records in my notes say that this place was once modified for use as fortifications from which the monsters could be attacked, although it didn't see much use in that regard.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Strange, isn't it? Why would the Dahrians, who triggered the defiling disaster, create machines to fight monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: All the same, now that we have activated the control systems for these ruins, the defensive mechanisms within the proving ground must also have been activated.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: The Great Song we are searching for should be within that Golem. Though I am stymied, I suspect that it will prove easy for you all.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Please allow me to stay here and await your return, so that we may be able to obtain all the Great Songs of Khvarena.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Well, you are indeed but a mere human. Such a request is to be expected.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: By your gracious leave, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, guess Nasejuna's slipping off at the last moment. Still, Paimon's a lot happier now that the two of you won't be bouncing off each other for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: If I went along with you, I suspect I would only drag you all down. As such, I shall simply wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: But I believe that whether it be Dahrian machines or the monsters of Dev, they shall be no match for the great Envoy or yourself.

talks.objective: Use the Ruin Cannon to destroy the Golem's core
Obtain the Great Song of Khvarena

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Ah, as one might expect of the great Envoy and her Yasnapati. Neither the Dahrian machines nor the creatures of Dev were able to stop you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? When did you get in here, Nasejuna?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Why, I was watching your wondrous battles from the side, and oh, what a sight it was! Then, upon seeing that you had the Great Song in hand, I rushed to meet with you, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Good work, all of you. And while we're on this topic, perhaps you might give the Great Songs of Khvarena to me for safekeeping? I mean, well, it might... How should I say this... give me a greater sense of my participation in our grand endeavor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you didn't do all that much from the start, and anyway, Zurvan said that we shouldn't give the Great Songs of Khvarena away carelessly.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Oh, don't say that. I mean, I have done so much research on them! I'm sure that a little examination on my part will be of help later!

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: For example, we could find out why these Great Songs of Khvarena have come to be hidden in these ruins, and...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: This is not the time for stories, Nasuraia.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! We need to go to the next place where we can find a Great Khvarena, don't we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can tell us your stories again once we've gotten them all, Nasejuna.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Well... alright.

response.text: Ah, so you have seen such devices before, have you? That makes things much easier for us.
